$comment: Contract cases a flow fails on main, by driver id and case id, each with the issue that fixes it. contract.test.ts runs these as it.fails: fix one and its test turns red until the line here goes. gate.test.ts refuses a public frame with any line here. This file only shrinks (#621).

lululemon-mirror.auth-refused-while-booting: #621: FlashSession.connectAdb stops at the first refusal and leaves the error on the adb screen
lululemon-mirror.usb-drop: #621: Try again (Back to the files) goes back to the image step, two steps before the write that stopped
lululemon-mirror.reload@install: #621: FlashSession keeps nothing across a page load, so the new page doesn't know the Mirror was being written
lululemon-mirror.reload@first-boot: #621: after a reload the page starts again at the image, knowing nothing, so finishing means flashing again
lululemon-mirror.stalled-download: #621: resumableBody has no stall watchdog, so a download that stops sending waits for ever

lululemon-mirror/app.auth-refused-while-booting: #621: MirrorSession.connect stops at the first refusal
lululemon-mirror/app.reload@install: #621: MirrorSession keeps nothing across a page load, so the new page doesn't know the app was going in
lululemon-mirror/app.no-touch: #621: installMirror waits for a tap on Android's chooser, and the Mirror has no touchscreen

generic-android.auth-refused-while-booting: #621: AndroidSession.connect stops at the first refusal
generic-android.reload@install: #621: AndroidSession keeps nothing across a page load, so the new page doesn't know the app was going in
